entities.summary: Domènec Fita i Molat was a Spanish artist. entities.summary: Domènec Fita i Molat was a Spanish artist. Having studied in different schools of classical fine arts, his work was gradually stripped of academicism, as evidenced already in his first notable works: the Recumbent Christ (1958), the Cathedral of Girona, and Saint Benedict (1961) the abbey of Montserrat.
